desc_en: A bold reinterpretation of utilitarian aesthetics. These leggings feature an all-over camouflage print that defines a commanding presence. Designed for those who demand distinction in every movement, they combine a form-fitting silhouette with an unmistakable graphic character. Each piece is crafted strictly to order and available with worldwide shipping.

Diseñados para quienes exigen distinción en cada movimiento, combinan una silueta ceñida con un carácter gráfico inconfundible. Cada pieza se confecciona exclusivamente bajo pedido y cuenta con envío a todo el mundo.
